title: Understanding Head Geometry and Dynamics in Federated Regression through a Natural Solution Selection Rule: An Unconstrained Feature Model Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.39464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In federated averaging, local objectives can admit multiple optimal heads, making the aggregate depend on which heads clients return. We study this ambiguity in federated multivariate regression with private backbones and a shared linear head, using an unconstrained feature model (UFM) that treats training-sample features as free variables. We introduce a natural selection rule: each client returns the optimal head closest to the broadcast head. We show that global minimization with a vanishing proximal penalty on the head realizes this rule. When the clients' optimal Gram matrices and the initial shared Gram matrix are positive definite, the shared Gram matrix follows a closed recursion and converges to the unique Bures-Wasserstein barycenter of the clients' optimal Gram matrices. translated_title: 通过自然解选择规则理解联邦回归中预测头的几何结构与动力学：基于无约束特征模型的分析
translated_abstract: 在联邦平均中，局部目标函数可能存在多个最优预测头，这使得聚合结果取决于客户端返回哪一个最优头。我们在采用私有骨干网络和共享线性头的联邦多元回归中研究这种歧义性，使用将训练样本特征视为自由变量的无约束特征模型（UFM）。我们引入一个自然的选择规则：每个客户端返回距离广播头最近的最优头。我们证明，对头施加趋于消失的近端惩罚的全局最小化过程可以实现该规则。当客户端的最优 Gram 矩阵与初始共享 Gram 矩阵均为正定时，共享 Gram 矩阵遵循一个封闭的递推关系，并收敛到客户端最优 Gram 矩阵的唯一 Bures-Wasserstein 重心。即使实现了这种对齐，该极限通常仍与集中式最优 Gram 矩阵不同。我们将这一差距分解为三个半正定项……
tldr: 本文通过无约束特征模型分析联邦回归中多最优解的歧义性，证明在自然解选择规则下共享Gram矩阵会收敛到客户端最优Gram矩阵的Bures-Wasserstein重心，并揭示了其与集中式最优解之间可分解的固有差距。
en_tdlr: Using an unconstrained feature model, this paper shows that under a natural solution selection rule in federated regression, the shared Gram matrix converges to the Bures-Wasserstein barycenter of clients' optimal Gram matrices, while a decomposable gap to the centralized optimum generally remains.
